Use case: style-transfer. Production sprite sheet for Crossroads Realms Beyond. Match soft coloured edges, matte shading and neutral poses of our V207/V208 sprites. Image 1 shows STYLE reference heroes, not costumes to copy. Image 2 shows EXISTING identities to preserve. Soft-edged COARSE PIXEL ART, clean square-pixel clusters, restrained related midtones, thin selective coloured contours. Gently dimensional fur, fabric, wood or matte armour. No black sticker border, no glossy bevels, no white rim, no whole-body glow/haze. Distinct body shapes and species retained. Modest polish, not redesign. Readable at 50-70px gameplay size.
FOUR COLUMNS per row: idle, walk A, walk B, attack. ALL head/torso neutral FRONT FACING, both eyes visible. Movement and attacks work in any direction. Fixed body/head scale and baseline; alternate lower legs, no full-body hopping, no weapon switching hands. Attack is contained neutral brace/cast, no shot flying sideways. Truly transparent background, no shadows, scenery, labels or words. Large gutters between every frame.
EIGHT ROWS, TOP TO BOTTOM (32 full-body sprites):
1. Sable Voss: dark charcoal hood and face-concealing mask, single amber eye slit, muted plum cloak, slate breastplate and violet crescent blades/implements, small framed violet weapon on both hands as reference.
2. Brass Bastion: charcoal hood/mask, amber eye slit, gold-brass shield viewer left and short gold hammer viewer right, brass breastplate, dark navy legs.
3. Cinder Oracle: burgundy hood, dark masked face and amber slit, rust-red tunic, slate breastplate, upright orange crystal staff viewer right.
4. Lumen Vale: cream hood with tan human face, muted mint-green robe/cape, pale yellow chest panel, upright pale aqua crystal staff viewer left.
5. Thorn Reedwarden: muted olive-green angular pointed-ear face/hood, yellow slit eyes, green tunic, leaf-green shield viewer left and spear viewer right, dark navy legs. Keep as original woodland guardian.
6. Iona Stormglass: angular slate-blue hood and pale blue visible face, navy/teal robes, blue chest piece, ice-blue geometric spear/blade viewer left and shield viewer right.
7. Flint Gearwright: tan/brown human-like face under dark slate cap, round aqua monocle over viewer right eye, leather/tan armour, broad slate/brass cannon held across body. No firing direction implied.
8. Ramguard area caster (see Image 3): cream wool ram with curled tan horns, slate helmet, navy tunic with muted lavender front panel, tall pale-aqua staff viewer right. Match newer town guards, simple small cream cross, no shield.

intro:
Use case: identity-preserve. Correct six cinematic walking poses from Image 1. Preserve EXACT Young Ram and Bramble designs, palette, coarse pixel-art simplicity and costume. This is ONLY an alternating-foot correction. The ram has cream wool, tan curled horns, navy tunic, brass belt buckle, brown gloves/boots. Bramble is the red-brown root creature with twig points and cream square eyes, NOT a leafy green bush.
EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, 6 full body frames on genuinely transparent background, no text, scenery, shadow or glow. Row 1: Young Ram walks toward viewer RIGHT in the SAME mild three-quarter angle as reference: left foot forward in first column, RIGHT foot forward in second column. Opposite arm swing, identical head/torso anchor and height. Row 2: Bramble approaches toward viewer LEFT in mild three-quarter pose: left foot forward then RIGHT foot forward. Row 3: SAME Bramble retreats toward viewer RIGHT: left foot forward then RIGHT foot forward. Explicitly SHOW THE OTHER FOOT in frame B; do not draw two poses of the same foot lifted. No whole body squash or hopping. Cinematic directional poses are intentional here, not gameplay heroes. Coarse clean pixel clusters, soft coloured contours, matte shading matching reference. Fixed scale per pair, generous gutters.

Preserve these designs, all cream rams with tan curled horns, navy clothing, matte slate steel helmets, brown gloves/boots, cream trim. Upgrade area caster to their same quality. Soft coloured pixel contours, matte shading, coarse clean square-pixel clusters, no thick black borders, no halo.
THREE ROWS and FOUR COLUMNS. Columns idle, walk A, walk B, attack. All neutral FRONT FACING for movement in any direction; both eyes visible. Fixed head/torso baseline in all frames, left foot then right foot for steps. Fixed equipment sides, nothing disappearing, no extra arms or outgoing directional projectile. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no labels/scenery/shadows. Generous transparent gutters.
Row 1: existing town navy Ramguard soldier, blue shield with small gold cross viewer LEFT, upright short spear viewer RIGHT, contained braced attack.
Row 2: existing navy Ramguard archer, upright wooden bow viewer RIGHT, quiver behind viewer LEFT shoulder. NO SHIELD in ANY pose. Contained bow-draw attack, torso stays front-facing.
Row 3: Ramguard area caster, slate helmet and cream wool horns, navy tunic and muted lavender tabard with small cream cross, pale-aqua crystal staff viewer RIGHT. Contained staff-raise attack. No shield.
archerfix: Use case: identity-preserve. Supporting image is the Wildwood Alliance troop atlas. Produce ONLY the deer archer from row 2, corrected to have NO SHIELD in any pose. Match this existing tan deer with branching antlers, teal tunic/coat, cream trim, dark trousers/boots, upright wooden bow on viewer right, small quiver on back. Same soft-edged coarse pixel art, matte shading and thin coloured contours. ONE ROW of FOUR full-body poses: idle, walk A, walk B, attack. Neutral front torso/head, both eyes visible; consistent head baseline, alternate feet. Keep bow in same hand throughout, no extra weapons/limbs. Transparent background, no labels/scenery/shadows, generous gutters.
tollbreaker: Use case: style-transfer. Upgrade ONLY this existing Tollbreaker boss for Crossroads. Preserve the horned slate helmet with two long tan side horns, narrow amber eye slit, huge gold-brass shield-like trapezoid torso made of horizontal plates, circular brass buckle on dark belt at lower front, massive grey gauntlets and stocky armoured legs. It is a large intimidating armoured construct, not a cute wool ram, no face revealed. Soft coloured selective contours, coarse clean square-pixel clusters, matte shaded brass and slate armour matching V207/V208. NO black sticker outline, gloss or aura. ONE ROW, FOUR full-body poses: idle, heavy walking left-foot step, heavy walking RIGHT-foot step, contained raised-gauntlet attack. Head and torso remain front facing with fixed size and baseline. Heavy leg motion without whole-body hopping. Keep shoulder horns and equipment identical in all poses. Actual transparent background with generous gutters, no scenery/labels/shadows, readable around 120px gameplay size.
